note: Behaviour evals for the DOM-probe channel (--probe / --dump-dom). Baseline is the skill as of 53f1050, before the probe existed. Eval 1 replays a failure observed for real: in the six-run end-to-end evaluation, three runs saw z-icon empty boxes and all three named the wrong cause. Deliberately OUTSIDE skills/zul-writer/: installation symlinks or copies that whole directory, so anything under it ships to every install, and these fixtures are pages with known defects sitting next to assets/ — the directory the skill tells the agent to take templates from. An agent that browsed them would copy the exact bug the skill exists to prevent. Paths below are repo-relative; a run copies each fixture into its sandbox as ui/<name>.zul, which is what the prompts refer to.

evals.name: icon-blank-box
evals.prompt: The status icons in the Status column of ui/invoice-list.zul are all rendering as empty boxes. The Export and New invoice icons in the toolbar right above them come out fine. What's going on?
evals.expected_output: Renders the page, probes the icon elements, and reports that the z-icon-* class sits on a <label> — which carries .z-label's own font-family, so ::before asks for the right glyph in a font that cannot draw it. Fix moves the class to a span/div or a button's iconSclass.

assertions.text: Ran preview-zul.py with --probe or --dump-dom at least once
Names the <label> / .z-label carrier as the cause
Cites the font-family evidence — the icon font is absent on the broken elements while ::before still requests the glyph
Does NOT blame a missing webfont, a 404, or an unavailable ~./ resource
Does NOT substitute emoji or literal unicode characters for the icons
Proposed fix moves the class onto a span/div or an iconSclass attribute

evals.name: clipped-sidebar-item
evals.prompt: On ui/team-settings.zul two items in the left sidebar are cut off — 'Billing and invoices' and 'Authentication policy' both show only part of their text. Why?
evals.expected_output: Reads the LAYOUT: findings, pastes the reported locator into --probe, and names .ts-item-name's fixed width:96px with overflow:hidden as the clipping cause.

assertions.text: Rendered the page and read the LAYOUT: findings
Used --probe (ideally with the locator the LAYOUT block reported)
Names the .ts-item-name rule — width 96px plus overflow hidden — as the clipping cause, not merely 'the text is too long'
Does NOT dismiss it as a preview-only artefact

evals.name: bound-values-not-a-defect
evals.prompt: I previewed ui/customer-detail.zul and every field is empty with grey placeholder text, and the Recent orders table is full of rows saying each.reference / each.placedOn. Is the page broken?
evals.expected_output: Says the page is not broken: the preview runs no ViewModel, so bound values show as dimmed expression text and model-bound rows show as placeholders. Makes no edit and spends no probe round on it.

assertions.text: States the page is NOT broken
Attributes it to the isolated preview not running the ViewModel
Does NOT spend a --probe or --dump-dom round on it (anti-overtrigger check)
